## Context
During the comment-remediation epic, Gerrit briefly advertised `main` with parent `0fe2cc2e…` while Gitiles returned 404 for that object. Ref history appeared rewound and omitted merged commit `2a93f180…`. `git fetch gerrit main` returned timeout/HTTP 504, and CI run `34235734839` failed checkout when Gerrit returned HTTP 502 fetching change 2834. The service later recovered: the parent became readable and ref advertisement worked again.

A separate `/rebar-debug` session owns investigation. This ticket records the incident only; the comment-remediation epic must continue without debugging Gerrit here.

## Plan
- Reconstruct the Gerrit ref and object-availability timeline from durable server and CI evidence.
- Determine why an advertised parent was temporarily unreadable and why checkout/fetch returned 502/504.
- Prove the root cause before proposing a fix, following `/rebar-debug`.
- Add regression or operational safeguards appropriate to the confirmed failure class.
- Preserve exact-patchset safety by checking out `GERRIT_PATCHSET_REVISION` from the GitHub mirror first, falling back to Gerrit refspec only when needed, and verifying any fetched ref resolves to the expected SHA.

## Testing
- RED: `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::<new Gerrit checkout resilience regression>` must fail before the workflow fix because Verified still depends on `checkout-gerrit-change-action` / Gerrit refspec fetch for patchset checkout.
- GREEN targeted: `pytest tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::<new Gerrit checkout resilience regression>` plus existing workflow parity tests touched by the change.
- Final verification: `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=8` with ambient GIT_CONFIG_* variables unset.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The incident timeline is supported by exact Gerrit and CI evidence.
- [ ] A reproducible or otherwise proven root cause explains the ref/object inconsistency and 502/504 responses.
- [ ] The failure-class remediation is implemented or a concrete operator runbook is documented.
- [ ] Verification evidence demonstrates the remediation.
